item.title: New JavaScript Framework Released
item.description: A new open-source JavaScript framework, "Starboard", launched today with claims of reducing bundle sizes by 40% versus comparable SPA runtimes. Its architects cite a custom compiler and minimal runtime.

item.title: PostgreSQL 17 Performance Improvements
item.description: PostgreSQL 17 ships with substantial query-planner changes: the team reports measurable gains for analytical workloads, and improved vacuum throughput on high-write tables.

item.title: Cloud Security Best Practices for 2026
item.description: CISA updated its cloud security guidance for 2026 — headline items include enforced MFA across IAM roles and mandatory rotation of long-lived service keys every 90 days.
